name: Can upgraded insulation help reduce noise from outside?

mainEntity.name: Can upgraded insulation help reduce noise from outside?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, upgrading your home's insulation can significantly contribute to noise reduction from external sources. Denser insulation materials, particularly spray foam or certain types of blown-in cellulose, act as sound barriers, absorbing sound waves and preventing them from traveling through walls and ceilings. While insulation primarily focuses on thermal performance, its acoustic benefits are a welcome bonus, creating a quieter and more peaceful indoor environment. This can be especially beneficial for homes located near busy streets or commercial areas.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, denser insulation materials can help reduce outside noise by absorbing sound waves, creating a quieter indoor environment.
